description: core §7.5, a heartbeat's collections. Written by an independent reading of the text (Python, standard library), checked, never blessed. `contracts` holds each revision's authoring text. `layouts`: a revision → its fingerprint, the heartbeat's tag (the low four bits of the fingerprint's last byte), and its collections in map order: each `state` or `@state` resource whose resolved `freshness.ttl_s` is above 0, by kind token then template, with its `cardinality` (`null` for a template with no parameter, one member), the width of its live count, ⌈log₂(cardinality + 1)⌉ bits (`null` with one member), and its horizon. A stream, a horizon of 0 and no horizon make no collection.

contracts.bare.v1:
# core §7.5's heartbeat: a revision with no collection, so a body is its
# time alone.
[interface]
name  = "bare"
major = 1
minor = 0

[resources.note]
kind = "state"
type = { raw = "text/plain" }

[resources.level]
kind = "stream"
type = { raw = "text/plain" }
